messages.text: Donnarumma: Man City are not in transition, it's going to be a great season

metadata.summary: "This is who we are. This is our team. This is City."
metadata.content: Gianluigi Donnarumma interview: Man City goalkeeper insists club are not in a transition year and backs club to have a great season | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Gianluigi Donnarumma interview: Man City goalkeeper insists club are not in a transition year and backs club to have a great season Man City goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma speaks exclusively to Sky Sports' Sam Blitz about the club's faultless start to the campaign; after a summer of change, City have started on fire; watch Man City vs Sunderland live on Sky Sports this Sunday from 1pm, kick-off 2pm Sam Blitz Football Journalist @SamBIitz Tuesday 15 September 2026 16:48, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Manchester City goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma hails the performance of his teammates after their 1-0 win at Manchester United at the weekend and says that VAR controversies are part of the game. "This is who we are. This is our team. This is City." It's been a few days since the Manchester Derby victory but sat at Man City's training ground, Gianluigi Donnarumma is still basking in the glory. He's not interested in Erling Haaland's controversial winner - though he's still annoyed Phil Foden was "harshly" sent off earlier in the game - as something else pleased him. metadata.content: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Fairy Glen well fancied in John Musker Fillies' Stakes feature at Yarmouth | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Today on Sky Sports Racing: Fairy Glen well fancied in John Musker Fillies' Stakes feature at Yarmouth Simon & Ed Crisford's Fairy Glen drops back down to Listed level in the John Musker at Yarmouth on Wednesday; Ryan Moore in action at the Norfolk track; watch every race live on Sky Sports Racing Tuesday 15 September 2026 14:06, UK Image: Yarmouth opens its gates for day two of the Eastern Festival on Wednesday, live on Sky Sports Racing The Listed John Musker Fillies’ Stakes takes centre stage on day two of Yarmouth’s Eastern Festival on Wednesday, all live on Sky Sports Racing. 3.41 Yarmouth - Fairy Glen, Seet & Rhapsody clash The EBF Stallions John Musker Fillies' Stakes is the feature on an excellent midweek card at Yarmouth. Simon & Ed Crisford-trained filly Fairy Glen tops the ratings with a mark of 112, and this Group Two winner could prove hard to beat in this lesser grade. She was only narrowly beaten when fifth in the Group One Prix Vicomtesse Vigier back in May and has obvious claims if fit enough on her return. Rhapsody is a key player for William Haggas and Tom Marquand. A dual winner, she has filled the runner-up spot on her last two outings, and a similar effort would see her in the mix. Seet is lightly-raced and should have more to offer, while Sky Safari has not been seen since finished third in the Group Three Hop

messages.text: What next for Arsenal prodigy Dowman after latest statement display?

metadata.summary: Max Dowman has waited patiently for opportunities in Arsenal's first team, but when he gets them, he delivers.
metadata.content: Max Dowman: Arsenal prodigy delivers latest statement performance as Mikel Arteta urges caution over 16-year-old | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Max Dowman: Arsenal prodigy delivers latest statement performance as Mikel Arteta urges caution over 16-year-old Max Dowman scored twice for Arsenal in their 4-2 win at Ipswich Town in the Carabao Cup third round; the 16-year-old forward was making his first appearance of the season; Dowman has had to wait for his chance after becoming the Premier League's youngest scorer David Richardson Football Journalist Wednesday 16 September 2026 06:33, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Max Dowman opened the scoring with a clinical finish against Ipswich Max Dowman has waited patiently for opportunities in Arsenal's first team, but when he gets them, he delivers. Mikel Arteta has managed the prodigy carefully since his big moment last season, when he became the Premier League's youngest scorer in a vital 2-0 home win over Everton on their title charge. Dowman has played six times since then, mostly in cameos, and has been an unused substitute on four occasions this season. Last Saturday, he played an hour for the U21s in their 4-1 defeat to Chelsea while the first team won at Sunderland. Arteta warned Dowman afterwards that he must earn his minutes this season. metadata.content: Caroline Dubois sets course for undisputed championship fight with 'jealous, threatened' Alycia Baumgardner | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Caroline Dubois sets course for undisputed championship fight with 'jealous, threatened' Alycia Baumgardner With American rival Alycia Baumgardner challenging Elif Nur Turhan for IBF lightweight title, WBO and WBC champion Caroline Dubois wants to unify against WBA title holder Stephanie Han; Watch Elif Nur Turhan vs Alycia Baumgardner on November 9 live on Sky Sports John Dennen Sports Journalist @johndennen Tuesday 15 September 2026 23:56, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Caroline Dubois and Alycia Baumgardner get into a war of words and call each other out following the British boxer's win over Amelia Moore Caroline Dubois is looking to fight her way to an undisputed showdown with American rival Alycia Baumgardner next year. Baumgardner will challenge Elif Nur Turhan for the IBF lightweight world title, live on Sky Sports in the early hours of Monday November 9. Dubois, the unified WBC and WBO 135lb champion, expects to fight the winner for the undisputed crown but doesn't want to wait on the sidelines. She intends to add another belt to her collection and is targeting Stephanie Han, the WBA belt-holder, next. Bentley: Benn can 'skip the queue' for middleweight world title shot Not got Sky?
